name: Suita Kaede
source:
Weakness: Her legs. She gets turned on when her legs or feet are licked or touched.

[url=/c42932]Tsukushi's[/url] class' teacher. Lives together with only her younger sister [url=/c42874]Momiji[/url]. 
She has a very serious and strict personality, but because she has started working at the school only a while ago, she doesn't know her way around.

She is very kind towards the school nurse, [url=/c42876]Ayame[/url], who treats Kaede like her little sister.

"Did something worrisome happen? I shall give you some guidance."
